content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
ANGRAU Junior Research Fellow Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the ANGRAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University recruitment is Junior Research Fellow. This is a contract-based research position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment drive announced by ANGRAU.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Sc (Ag) in Genetics & Plant Breeding / Biotechnology / M. Sc (Life Sciences) from an ICAR Accredited University. NET certificates are preferred for PG students.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs.31000/- per month + HRA for NET/GATE qualified scholars and Rs. 25,000/- per month + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 01 October 2026. Candidates should report at the specified time.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role will be based on a Walk-in-Interview. Candidates will be assessed during this interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at the Chamber of Associate Director of Research, Regional Agricultural Research Station, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, 517502.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original certificates, publications, thesis, proof of date of birth, and one set of photostat copies of the certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.
